description: Implementation of OrganizationBlockingService class for organization-specific blocking operations, including methods for checking if emails or domains are blocked, with support for wildcard domain patterns.

classes.name: OrganizationBlockingService
classes.description: Service class for handling organization-specific blocking logic, implementing IBlockingService interface.

methods.name: isBlocked
methods.description: Checks if a specific email is blocked for a given organization, considering email and domain watchlist entries.

methods.name: areBlocked
methods.description: Bulk checks multiple emails for blocking status within an organization, supporting wildcard domain patterns.

methods.name: isDomainBlocked
methods.description: Checks if a specific domain is blocked for a given organization.
